item.title: Virgin Music Group completes acquisition of Downtown Music Holdings
item.description: Virgin Music Group (VMG) has completed its acquisition of Downtown Music Holdings, the company confirmed on 20 February. The transaction follows approval from the European Commission, granted on 13 February, subject to Universal Music Group (UMG) divesting Downtown’s Curve royalty accounting business. item.title: Spotify marks five years in Nigeria as local listening, discovery accelerate
item.description: Data received from Spotify indicate that music consumption in Nigeria has expanded sharply since the streaming service launched in the country in February 2021. Over the five-year period to 2025, year-on-year listening grew at an average rate of 163.5%, driven by sustained increases following triple-digit gains in the platform’s early years. item.title: SA: Freshlyground shares third single from forthcoming album
item.description: South African band Freshlyground has released ‘Take Me Home’, the third single from its upcoming album of the same name. The track marks a shift in the group’s sound, introducing a blues-influenced and soul-led approach that differs from its earlier Afropop-driven releases. The single features 20-year-old vocalist Mbali Makhoba, who has joined the band as lead singer. item.title: Suno appoints Jeremy Sirota as chief commercial officer
item.description: Music company Suno has appointed Jeremy Sirota as its chief commercial officer. Sirota, who previously served as CEO of Merlin, will oversee Suno’s commercial strategy, platform partnerships, music industry relationships, and enterprise solutions, reporting directly to CEO Mikey Shulman. Sirota’s career spans leadership roles across music, technology, and law. item.title: Spotify reports steady growth in Kenya five years after launch
item.description: Data released by Spotify show sustained growth in music streaming in Kenya since the platform launched in the country in February 2021. According to the figures, year-on-year listening in Kenya has increased consistently over the past five years, recording an average annual growth rate of 68% through to 2025. item.title: Open call: Goethe-Institut International Coproduction Fund
item.description: The Goethe-Institut has issued a call for applications for its International Coproduction Fund, which supports collaborative projects in music, theatre, dance and performance. The deadline for applications is 1 April 2026. The fund provides financial support for projects that demonstrate international cultural exchange and genuine artistic collaboration between partners based outside Germany and those working within Germany. item.title: Bassline Fest unveils Rhythmic Clash 2026 for emerging African talent
item.description: Bassline Fest, in South Africa, has opened applications for Rhythmic Clash 2026, a national talent discovery platform aimed at identifying and promoting emerging African artists. The initiative is part of the festival’s preparations for its 20th anniversary. Winning performers will secure a slot at Bassline Fest ‘Say Africa’ 2026, scheduled for 23 May 2026 at Constitution Hill, Johannesburg. item.title: Artist coalition urges music community to reject Suno AI platform
item.description: A coalition of artist representatives has published an open letter calling on the music community to reject the AI music generator Suno, citing concerns over copyright and the use of artists’ work to train generative systems. The letter, titled Say No to Suno, was published on 23 February on the Music Technology Policy blog.
